 # ADR-0063 — Bootstrap plan: the self-hosting boundary and the fixed-point criterion
 
 **Status:** Proposed
-**Implemented:** partial — **BEAM** self-hosting (§4): Stage 0/1 equivalence-locked (ported lexer + the **full `Rian.Pratt` grammar**, no projection; `Rian.Fixpoint`, `examples/rian/selfhost_*.rian`; `test/rian/fixpoint_test.exs`, `parse_fixpoint_test.exs`), the surface→Core lowering **fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_core.rian` equals `Rian.Core.from_expr`/`from_pat` over the whole surface-reachable expression+pattern vocabulary; `core_fixpoint_test.exs`), the capability checker ported over the scalar/String/Vec/nominal slice (`selfhost_cap.rian` equals `Rian.Capability`; `cap_fixpoint_test.exs`), the exhaustiveness gate ported over the single-column nullary-constructor slice (`selfhost_exhaust.rian` agrees with Maranget `useful?/3`; `exhaust_fixpoint_test.exs`), the ECMAScript backend's expression emitter ported over the literal/unary/binary slice (`selfhost_js.rian` equals `Rian.JS` term-for-term; `js_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **Kotlin/JVM and ECMAScript backends fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_jvm.rian` = `Rian.JVM.compile`, `selfhost_js.rian` = `Rian.JS.compile` — whole-module emission incl. sum types + multi-clause pattern dispatch + case/tuples/lists; `jvm_module_fixpoint_test.exs`/`js_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **BEAM backend fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_beam.rian` — whole-module abstract forms with native multi-clause dispatch — compiles via `:compile.forms` and runs identically to `Rian.Beam`; `beam_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **Rust backend fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_rust.rian` — whole-module emission with `enum`s + match-over-param-tuple dispatch + capability-lowered signatures — equals `Rian.Lower.rust_program`; `rust_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), a slice of the real type checker ported (`selfhost_checker.rian` agrees with `Rian.Check.infer` on closed integer expressions; `checker_infer_fixpoint_test.exs`); the **capability checker** and the **exhaustiveness gate** are now fully self-hosted (`selfhost_cap.rian` reproduces the whole `Rian.Capability` rust-param matrix; `selfhost_exhaust.rian` reproduces the complete Maranget `Rian.Exhaustiveness.useful?`), Stage 2 near-complete (decl front-end IR-equals `Rian.Decl`); the **composed `build`** (verified lexer + decl parser + beam backend, cross-module, driven by `selfhost_compose_real_sum.rian`) now self-compiles each **whole stage source** — the lexer (`compose_lexer_fixpoint_test.exs`), the decl parser (`compose_decl_whole_fixpoint_test.exs`), and the beam backend (`compose_beam_whole_fixpoint_test.exs`) — **and the driver itself**: v1 compiles its own whole source into a v2 driver that builds + runs programs identically to v1 (`compose_driver_whole_fixpoint_test.exs` — *the build compiling the build*, incl. cross-module remote calls, tuple/atom abstract-form construction, and `@external` FFI bodies parsed-and-spliced per ADR-0068). This is a **composition-level `v1==v2` (self-COMPILING)** — Stage 3 proper (the *whole* compiler incl. checker, **bit-identical** `.beam`) is **not** there. The marching boundary is **measured** (`Rian.SelfHost` → `docs/self-host-status.md`, `test/rian/self_host_status_test.exs`), FFI crutches are **counted+enforced** (`@selfhost_ffi` ledger, `self_host_ffi_test.exs`), and the two untested-fragility areas now have fixpoints with teeth (`checker_fixpoint_test.exs`, `string_emit_fixpoint_test.exs`). **Portable** self-hosting (compile-the-compiler to Rust/JS) is a *separate, further* terminus, gated on ADR-0047 breadth + the `Fn` Reach gap — not near.
+**Implemented:** partial — **BEAM** self-hosting (§4): Stage 0/1 equivalence-locked (ported lexer + the **full `Rian.Pratt` grammar**, no projection; `Rian.Fixpoint`, `examples/rian/selfhost_*.rian`; `test/rian/fixpoint_test.exs`, `parse_fixpoint_test.exs`), the surface→Core lowering **fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_core.rian` equals `Rian.Core.from_expr`/`from_pat` over the whole surface-reachable expression+pattern vocabulary; `exhaust_fixpoint_test.exs`), the ECMAScript backend's expression emitter ported over the literal/unary/binary slice (`selfhost_js.rian` equals `Rian.JS` term-for-term; `js_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **Kotlin/JVM and ECMAScript backends fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_jvm.rian` = `Rian.JVM.compile`, `selfhost_js.rian` = `Rian.JS.compile` — whole-module emission incl. sum types + multi-clause pattern dispatch + case/tuples/lists; `jvm_module_fixpoint_test.exs`/`js_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **BEAM backend fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_beam.rian` — whole-module abstract forms with native multi-clause dispatch — compiles via `:compile.forms` and runs identically to `Rian.Beam`; `beam_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), the **Rust backend fully self-hosted** (`selfhost_rust.rian` — whole-module emission with `enum`s + match-over-param-tuple dispatch + capability-lowered signatures — equals `Rian.Lower.rust_program`; `rust_module_fixpoint_test.exs`), a slice of the real type checker ported (`selfhost_checker.rian` agrees with `Rian.Check.infer` on closed integer expressions; `checker_infer_fixpoint_test.exs`); the **capability checker** and the **exhaustiveness gate** are now fully self-hosted (`selfhost_cap.rian` reproduces the whole `Rian.Capability` rust-param matrix; `selfhost_exhaust.rian` reproduces the complete Maranget `Rian.Exhaustiveness.useful?`), Stage 2 near-complete (decl front-end IR-equals `Rian.Decl`); the **composed `build`** (verified lexer + decl parser + beam backend, cross-module, driven by `selfhost_compose_real_sum.rian`) now self-compiles each **whole stage source** — the lexer (`compose_lexer_fixpoint_test.exs`), the decl parser (`compose_decl_whole_fixpoint_test.exs`), and the beam backend (`compose_beam_whole_fixpoint_test.exs`) — **and the driver itself**: v1 compiles its own whole source into a v2 driver that builds + runs programs identically to v1 (`compose_driver_whole_fixpoint_test.exs` — *the build compiling the build*, incl. cross-module remote calls, tuple/atom abstract-form construction, struct field access (`maps:get`), and `@external` FFI bodies parsed-and-spliced per ADR-0068). Whole-file self-compile locks now cover the **whole compiler-module set** (lexer/decl/beam/driver) plus the `selfhost_cap`/`selfhost_core`/`selfhost_exhaust` stages (`compose_selfcompile_fixpoint_test.exs`, `compose_stage_whole_fixpoint_test.exs`). **The bootstrap fixed point `v1 == v2` is CLOSED for the Rian compiler** (`selfhost_v1_v2_fixpoint_test.exs`): gen0 (Elixir-host-compiled) compiles the four compiler sources → gen1; gen1 recompiles the same sources → gen2; gen1 == gen2 in canonical forms **and** in bit-identical `.beam` (under `:deterministic`). Honest scope: this is `v1==v2` **for the Rian compiler — self-COMPILING, not self-CHECKING** (the gates are not in the loop), compared on forms (the canonical artifact). It is **not** a claim that `build` reproduces `Rian.Beam`'s bytecode — `Rian.Beam` additionally emits `-spec`/type attributes and runs Reach, so the host artifact is richer by design; a fully self-CHECKING compiler (Check/Exhaustiveness/Capability in the loop, the checker port still infer-only over 5/12 Core nodes) remains future. The marching boundary is **measured** (`Rian.SelfHost` → `docs/self-host-status.md`, `test/rian/self_host_status_test.exs`), FFI crutches are **counted+enforced** (`@selfhost_ffi` ledger, `self_host_ffi_test.exs`), and the two untested-fragility areas now have fixpoints with teeth (`checker_fixpoint_test.exs`, `string_emit_fixpoint_test.exs`). **Portable** self-hosting (compile-the-compiler to Rust/JS) is a *separate, further* terminus, gated on ADR-0047 breadth + the `Fn` Reach gap — not near.
 **Refs:** ADR-0027 (fast track to self-hosting), ADR-0031 (reuse the runtime, not the compiler; abstract-forms backend), ADR-0050 (typed core IR — one IR, many front/back ends), ADR-0047 (portable prelude — the stdlib the ported compiler leans on), SELFHOST.md (the blocker ledger + the lexer/parser fixpoints)
 **Owners:** Arthur Pendelton (compilers) · Chloe Bennett (parser) · Maya Lin (architecture) · Samir Patel (conformance) · Kira Neri (honesty) · Rachel Okafor (PM)

Remaining: a self-**checking** compiler (the gates in the loop; checker port still infer-only over 5/12 Core nodes) |
 
 **"Real self-hosting" = Stage 2** (the front-end genuinely self-hosts, reusing a trusted backend);
 **Stage 3** is the canonical bootstrap fixed point that retires the Elixir host entirely.

@@ -14,7 +14,7 @@ stages verified against the reference *in isolation* (each fixpoint uses Elixir
 projection glue); it can reach 100% without the pipeline ever closing a loop. The
 composition rung measures the orthogonal question — stages handing their Rian output
 to the next Rian stage with **no glue**. Current rung: **SelfhostLexerV2.tokenize → SelfhostDecl.parse_program → lower → SelfhostBeam.compile_forms → load**
-(4 stages), over the a whole multi-function module whose ENTIRE front-end is verified ports — tokenized by selfhost_lexer_v2, parsed by selfhost_decl (def heads, multi-clause patterns incl. cons-LISTS, SUM-TYPE declarations + constructor dispatch, `if`/comparison/boolean, arithmetic + calls; strings/`case` not yet) — and compiled by the selfhost_beam backend; all THREE ports called CROSS-MODULE, with only a surface→Core lowering + Form inflater as driver glue. Rungs 1-6 built a driver owning the source→loaded-module loop over a TOY pipeline. Rung 7 made the BACKEND verified (`selfhost_beam`); rung 8 made body-parsing verified (`selfhost_parse`); rung 9 made declaration-parsing verified (`selfhost_decl`); rung 10 makes LEXING verified too (`selfhost_lexer_v2`), so the driver owns NO lexing or parsing — the whole front-end AND the back-end are equivalence-locked ports, composed cross-module. The lexer's token tags are a superset of the parser's (same tags), so `SelfhostLexerV2.tokenize` feeds `SelfhostDecl.parse_program` with NO projection. The only driver-local code left reimplements no stage: the surface→Core lowering (selfhost_decl's Decl/Expr/Pat IR → selfhost_beam Core/Pat, incl. cons-list patterns → PList) and the Form inflater. Rung 11 widens the SURFACE to sum types + constructor dispatch using selfhost_decl's already-locked type/ctor capability (no port change — only the driver glue grows: `type` decls are erased, and the Form inflater learns FCtorN/FCtor via a to_snake matching Rian.PatternLower). Surface is now selfhost_decl's slice (arithmetic + calls + multi-clause + cons-lists + sum-type declarations/dispatch; list recursion like sum/len AND ctor dispatch like Color/Shape work). All ports load under :"Elixir.Selfhost*" atoms (Pascal calls, ADR-0041); sibling-port calls are composition, not host crutches (excluded from the FFI ledger). Only host FFI: :compile.forms/:code.load_binary. The fixpoint calls only build/2 and runs the result identically to the full Elixir toolchain. Rung 12 widens selfhost_decl ITSELF off its old :partial slice — `if … do … else … end` expressions now parse (equivalence-locked: decl_fixpoint diffs the projected IR against Rian.Decl.parse), and the build's lowering/inflater learn `if`→`case`, so the composed build compiles `if` end to end. The path to v1==v2: keep widening selfhost_decl (it still lacks `case`/strings/block bodies) and the surface→Core lowering to match, until build compiles a whole real selfhost_*.rian file.
